method: Each of the 13 final PNGs actually opened with tools.view_image and visually inspected.
per_image_opening_UTC: not individually captured; no invented per-image timestamps

c2st.png.note: All 10 fixed views and paired intervals readable; legend outside data; missing RAW 2D prediction explicit.

charge_psd.png.note: Common Q and PSD axes; full populations and narrow generated bands retained.

conditional_psd_CDF.png.note: Short bin titles, support counts and bin8 support gap visible.

energy_peak_width.png.note: Both component centers, raw/detrended widths and missing support shown without connecting gaps.

conditional_waveforms.png.note: Full 480-point raw mV conditional mean/median; residual tail structure remains visible.

noise_curvature.png.note: RMS, ACF and prompt/postpeak curvature units readable; prompt is not pure rising edge.

source_preservation.png.note: Actual preADC source-Q populations 213/181 and source proxies distinguished from truth.

boundary_differences.png.note: All nine prespecified boundaries and native mV distributions readable.

training_time_mixer.png.note: Actual step2950 J20 plotted, selected1250 record-only, gradients and initial-to-final changes explicit.

DEV_full_correlation.png.note: 480-coordinate description on common correlation scale; no DEV fit implied.

source_and_random_decomposition.png.note: Source input perturbation and corrected probe references clear; functional covariance terms include cross terms.

same_treated_REAL_controls.png.note: Gate lines apply only to shape/u/baseline; V480 descriptive; RAW identity not presumed.

final_module_action.png.note: Final module disabled is descriptive action, not a second candidate or retraining ablation.
